subject: Marine Works - Fraser River - North Arm
text:
Marine Works - Fraser River - North Arm
Dredging operations in Deering Island slough in the vicinity of 49 13.070N 123 10.889W.
Hours of operation Monday to Saturday from 1400 UTC to 0000 UTC. 
On site vessels monitoring VHF channels 04, 06, 16, 61 and 74. 
Minimum wake.
